No comments or suggestions have been received from the general public in response to the aforesaid notices published in the newspapers. None of the Respondents have filed their reply in the matter. 6. The hearing in this matter was held on 8.6.2021 and the Commission reserved the order in the matter. 7. Having heard the representatives of the Petitioner and after perusal of the materials on record, we proceed to dispose of the petition. Auditor Certificates in support of the same.
